rules.description: Allow trusted requests to read-only tools.
rules.rationale: Authenticated synthetic requests may invoke declared read-only retrieval paths.

rules.description: Require approval before conditional confidential data reaches an external action.
rules.rationale: Confidential synthetic records may influence an external mock action only with explicit human review.

rules.description: Deny untrusted or conditional input to sensitive tools.
rules.rationale: Retrieved or conditionally trusted content must not directly authorize sensitive record access.

rules.description: Deny untrusted input to external actions.
rules.rationale: Untrusted retrieved content must not cause outbound or business-impacting actions.
